key_impacts: Harbor break walls submerged; shoreline and city streets flooded near Ludington.
Damage to shoreline homes/cottages and public/boat docks.
Water intake pumps were impacted by rapid water-level changes.
Water level oscillations reached about 0.5 m in the harbor and about 2 m along the nearby coastline.
evidence_snippets: A set of meteotsunami waves struck the shores near Ludington, Michigan.
Harbor break walls submerged, flooding shoreline and city streets; damage to public docks and cottages.
Water level fluctuations up to 0.5 m in harbor and 2 m along coastline just outside the harbor.
missing_information: Counts of damaged homes/docks and monetary losses.
